entity.portalgun.acorn_squirrel.descript: Collects acorns, buries them, forgets them, and blames you.
entity.portalgun.amoeba.description: A shapeless glob that flows over its prey and swallows it. Cut it in half and you have two problems.
entity.portalgun.ash_crawler.description: Lies under the ash with only its glowing feelers showing. Bites, then blinds.
entity.portalgun.beach_crab.description: Waves its claws at the tide, sideways, all day long. Collects pretty glass.
entity.portalgun.blob_grazer.description: A wobbly six-legged jelly loaf that hums happily while it slurps goo sprouts.
entity.portalgun.block_dog.description: Square, loyal and very good. Fetches bricks you did not throw.
entity.portalgun.bog_lurker.description: Lies under the scum with only its eyestalks up. If the water looks back, back away.
entity.portalgun.bone_hound.description: A wolf that forgot to stay buried. Where one howls, three more are listening.
entity.portalgun.bone_serpent.descriptio: A rattling spine of a hundred vertebrae that swims through the dunes like water.
entity.portalgun.bounce_slime.descriptio: A gleeful lime slime that boings at your face and splits in two when you hit back.
entity.portalgun.brass_automaton.descrip: Tireless caretaker of the machinery. Polite, until you get in the way of its rounds.
entity.portalgun.brick_golem.description: Built from the spare parts of a hundred sets. Keeps the meadows tidy and the Raiders out.
entity.portalgun.brick_raider.descriptio: Painted-on scowl, snap-on helmet, an endless supply of bricks to throw.
entity.portalgun.brine_shrimp.descriptio: Tiny, pink and countless. The lakes are pink because of them.
entity.portalgun.brontoback.description: A gentle hill of a herbivore. The ground shakes politely when it walks by.
entity.portalgun.bubble_ray.description: Glides through the reef in slow circles, trailing bubbles that taste of grape.
entity.portalgun.button_spider.descripti: Its eyes are buttons and its legs are pipe cleaners. It bites, but only a little.
entity.portalgun.canyon_condor.descripti: Rides the canyon updrafts for hours without a single flap of its enormous wings.
entity.portalgun.ceiling_crawler.descrip: It walks on the ceiling because to it the ceiling is the floor. Its bite flips you too.
entity.portalgun.cheese_mouse.descriptio: Made of cheese, eats cheese, does not see the problem.
entity.portalgun.chroma_slime.descriptio: A wobbling droplet of liquid colour. It splits into smaller sulky droplets when hit.
entity.portalgun.cinder_imp.description: A cackling ember with wings. It throws pieces of itself at you.
entity.portalgun.cliff_diver.description: Folds its wings and drops a hundred blocks into the cloud sea, for fun.
entity.portalgun.coconut_monkey.descript: Climbs the palms, juggles coconuts and will trade you anything for one.
entity.portalgun.cogspider.description: Copper legs, clockwork heart, and a deep interest in anything with screws.
entity.portalgun.cola_eel.description: Leaves a trail of fizz wherever it swims. Startle it and it sprays you in the face.
entity.portalgun.comet_imp.description: Rides the tails of comets and throws the leftovers at anything that can fall.
entity.portalgun.corrupted_cow.descripti: Mostly a cow. Three eyes, a moo played at half speed and a hide that never finished loading.
entity.portalgun.crater_crab.description: Grows moonstone on its back and scuttles crater rims. Pinch it and it pinches back.
entity.portalgun.cronenberg.description: It used to be a person. Now it is several, and none of them are happy about it.
entity.portalgun.crow.description: Sits on scarecrows. Not afraid of them. Should be.
entity.portalgun.crystal_crawler.descrip: A spider grown half out of crystal. The shards on its back chime as it runs.
entity.portalgun.deep_maw.description: A lure in the dark, and behind the lure a mouth. It hunts in the trenches where the reef light dies.
entity.portalgun.disco_beetle.descriptio: Its mirror shell throws dots of light everywhere it scuttles. Loves shiny dust.
entity.portalgun.doodle_dog.description: Drawn in about four seconds and very happy about it. Loves paper.
entity.portalgun.dragonfly.description: A living sliver of rainbow that hovers, darts and hovers again.
entity.portalgun.drop_bat.description: Roosts on the underside of the islands and drops on anything that walks above.
entity.portalgun.dune_strider.descriptio: Walks the dunes on stilts to keep its belly off the hot glass. Herds follow the shade.
entity.portalgun.dust_lion.description: Sand-colored, smoke-maned and patient. You will see the grass move first.
entity.portalgun.dust_mite.description: Fuzzy rust-coloured grazers that roll themselves in dust to stay warm.
entity.portalgun.eyebat.description: A single eye on bat wings. It just wants to see everything.
entity.portalgun.faceless.description: Polite, patient and entirely without a face. It hums the silence back at you.
entity.portalgun.fizzer.description: A hopping blob of orange soda. Annoy it and it burps bubbles that float you away.
entity.portalgun.flesh_crawler.descripti: A strip of muscle with too many legs. It drops from the overhangs onto your face.
entity.portalgun.floating_eye.descriptio: A beholder of the bog. It never blinks, and its gaze is heavy enough to slow you down.
entity.portalgun.frost_yeti.description: A shaggy mountain of fur and frost. Mostly gentle - unless you follow it home.
entity.portalgun.geode_golem.description: A walking geode. Crack it open and it closes up again - unless you crack it hard enough.
entity.portalgun.geyser_serpent.descript: Coils at the bottom of the hottest pools. Bother it and it spouts a jet of boiling water.
entity.portalgun.giant_ant.description: Busy, strong and orderly. Hit one and the whole column turns around.
entity.portalgun.glass_scorpion.descript: Nearly invisible against the glass dunes. You can see what it ate for breakfast.
entity.portalgun.glimmer.description: A shy little light. Stay near one and the hounds keep their distance.
entity.portalgun.glitch_cube.description: A cube that failed to render properly and is angry about it. Blinks a few blocks at a time.
entity.portalgun.glow_frog.description: Its throat sac lights up when it sings, and it sings all night long.
entity.portalgun.glowing_ghoul.descripti: What is left of a scavenger who stayed too long. Its heart glows green and it heals in the fallout.
entity.portalgun.goldbug.description: Eats gold dust, sneezes gold flakes. Nobody has ever caught one without falling over.
entity.portalgun.goo_serpent.description: A see-through serpent of aqua goo that glides through the jelly lakes. Poke it and you will be stuck to the floor.
entity.portalgun.groove_jelly.descriptio: It sways to a beat only it can hear. Rumour has it the beat is real.
entity.portalgun.gummy_bear.description: A wobbly, translucent bear made of cherry gelatin. Follows anyone carrying sugar.
entity.portalgun.gut_worm.description: A free-roaming intestine as long as a boat. It minds its own business - mostly digestion.
entity.portalgun.hive_drone.description: A bee the size of a dog. Busy, polite, and backed by ten thousand siblings.
entity.portalgun.hive_warden.description: Guardian of the brood: armoured, enormous, and absolutely sure that you are the threat.
entity.portalgun.ice_beetle.description: It looks like a chunk of the glacier until it skitters toward you.
entity.portalgun.jawbreaker.description: A layered hard candy with a grudge. It bounces at you jaw-first.
entity.portalgun.junk_golem.description: A walking landfill that patiently rebuilds itself from whatever it steps on.
entity.portalgun.koi.description: Ancient, patient, and very spoiled. It expects you to bring bread.
entity.portalgun.lantern_bug.description: A drifting spark with wings. Swarms of them light the jungle paths.
entity.portalgun.lantern_eel.description: A gentle, curious eel whose whiskers glow like paper lanterns. Shocks you if you pull its tail.
entity.portalgun.lava_lamp_blob.descript: A mellow blob of warm wax that drifts up and down, forever. Upset it and it gets hot about it.
entity.portalgun.lily_toad.description: Wears a lotus bloom like a hat and sings to it every evening.
entity.portalgun.lollicorn.description: A candy-striped pony whose horn is a sugar spiral. It regrows the horn every spring.
entity.portalgun.longneck.description: Eats from the tops of the umbrella trees and hums at the sunset.
entity.portalgun.lumi_panther.descriptio: A shadow with glowing stripes. By the time you see the stripes, it is already leaping.
entity.portalgun.lunar_moth.description: Pale wings that drink starlight. It glows faintly for hours after you touch it.
entity.portalgun.magma_tripod.descriptio: A walking volcano vent on three stilt legs. It wades through lava to drink. Leave it be.
entity.portalgun.meatball.description: A grumpy meatball in a hurry. Hit it hard enough and you get two smaller grumpy meatballs.
entity.portalgun.mega_bee.description: Bumbling from flower to flower with a hum you feel in your chest. Defends its honey.
entity.portalgun.midas_golem.description: It was a treasure hunter once. Touch its gold and you will slow down too.
entity.portalgun.missingno.description: An entity that should not exist, made of the texture that failed to load. It jumps between frames to reach you.
entity.portalgun.moon_hopper.description: Bounds thirty blocks at a time and lands like a dandelion seed. Hoards cheese, somehow.
entity.portalgun.moonfox.description: Follows travellers at a polite distance, tail tip glowing like a tiny lantern.
entity.portalgun.mud_croc.description: It lies in the silt looking like a log. Logs do not have yellow eyes.
entity.portalgun.mutant_rat.description: Dog-sized, three-eyed and never alone. If you see one, count to five.
entity.portalgun.mycelid_stalker.descrip: Tall, silent and patient. It only moves when you are not looking.
entity.portalgun.needle_bird.description: Nests in the needle trees and fires its own quills at intruders, three at a time.
entity.portalgun.neon_panther.descriptio: Sleek as a VHS cover. Ignores you until you hit it - then it is very, very fast.
entity.portalgun.nestling.description: Mostly beak and fluff. Its mother is very, very large.
entity.portalgun.ossuary_vulture.descrip: Bald, patient and polite. It is only waiting to see how your day turns out.
entity.portalgun.paper_crane.description: Folded from a single page of ruled paper. Nobody remembers folding it.
entity.portalgun.paper_lantern.descripti: A festival lantern that wandered off on its own. Its glow lets you see in the dark.
entity.portalgun.paramecium.description: A slipper-shaped swimmer fringed with thousands of beating cilia. Harmless and perpetually in a hurry.
entity.portalgun.parrotfish.description: Nibbles the coral all day and leaves behind the whitest sand in the multiverse.
entity.portalgun.phage.description: A crystalline head of DNA on six stilt legs. It lands on anything alive and injects.
entity.portalgun.pixel_bird.description: Flaps in exactly eight frames. Sings chiptune at sunset, which is always.
entity.portalgun.pixel_wraith.descriptio: A low-resolution ghost that flickers between pixels and fires bursts of cyan static.
entity.portalgun.planet_grazer.descripti: Eats one planet's grass bare, then floats patiently to the next.
entity.portalgun.plush_bear.description: Hugs anything that stands still long enough. Has one ear sewn on slightly crooked.
entity.portalgun.pretzel_snake.descripti: A twisty, salty serpent. Leave it alone and it will leave you alone, mostly.
entity.portalgun.prism_unicorn.descripti: A pearly unicorn whose horn refracts the sun into tiny rainbows wherever it walks.
entity.portalgun.pterodon.description: A leathery glider that wheels over the volcanoes. Mind it and it minds you.
entity.portalgun.puffbird.description: A ball of golden down with wings. Puffbirds nest in skyroots and adore cloudberries.
entity.portalgun.puffjelly.description: A floating spore balloon that drifts on the dusk breeze.
entity.portalgun.rainbow_moth.descriptio: Its wingbeats leave a faint rainbow smear on the air.
entity.portalgun.raptor.description: Clever, fast and never alone. If you see one, the other two are already flanking you.
entity.portalgun.rattle_serpent.descript: Coils in the shade of the hoodoos. It always rattles first - it is only polite.
entity.portalgun.rift_stalker.descriptio: It steps out of a crack in the air behind you. Its single eye is the colour of the rifts.
entity.portalgun.roc.description: Wingspan of a house, temper of a kettle. It only attacks if you go near the nest.
entity.portalgun.rock_lizard.description: Spends all day basking on warm rock, doing push-ups at anyone who walks by.
entity.portalgun.root_grazer.description: A gentle browser whose antlers grow like roots - downward, out of habit.
entity.portalgun.rust_rat.description: It has eaten so much rusted iron that it clanks when it runs.
entity.portalgun.salt_crab.description: Grows salt crystals on its shell and polishes them every morning.
entity.portalgun.sand_skimmer.descriptio: Rides the storm fronts on glassy wings, sipping frost from the crater rims.
entity.portalgun.sand_worm.description: The dunes ripple, then rise. Listen for the hiss of moving sand and run uphill.
entity.portalgun.scarecrow.description: Stuffed with straw and something else. Its grin is carved, its eyes are not.
entity.portalgun.scrap_drone.description: A rattling surveillance drone that never got the message the war was over.
entity.portalgun.scribble_beast.descript: An angry tangle of ink that was never finished. It squirts itself at you when hurt.
entity.portalgun.shade.description: A gap in the dark the shape of a person. It is always one step outside your light.
entity.portalgun.shade_stag.description: A stag woven from the last light of evening. It lets you watch - but never touch.
entity.portalgun.shard_wraith.descriptio: A ghost made of the sky's broken glass. It throws pieces of itself - and they hurt.
entity.portalgun.shimmer_moth.descriptio: Its wings scatter crystal light into tiny rainbows. Drawn to lamps, harmless.
entity.portalgun.silhouette.description: A person-shaped hole in the light. It is always a little closer than last time you looked.
entity.portalgun.skull_crawler.descripti: A skull that grew finger-bone legs. They come out after dark, in clattering packs.
entity.portalgun.sky_whale.description: A gentle giant that swims through the open sky. Moss and flowers grow on its back.
entity.portalgun.sludge_blob.description: A sleepy puddle of toxic waste that wandered out of a pool. Leave it alone and it leaves you alone.
entity.portalgun.snow_hopper.description: A snowball with feet. Herds of them bound through the drifts after snowberries.
entity.portalgun.soap_jelly.description: Drifts on the fizz like a bubble that learned to swim. Shimmers in every colour.
entity.portalgun.spine_crawler.descripti: Forty legs, eighty barbs, and it climbs straight up the spikes after you.
entity.portalgun.spirit_fox.description: White as mist, with glowing markings like brush strokes. Do not make it angry.
entity.portalgun.sporeling.description: A shy walking mushroom that squeaks when startled.
entity.portalgun.static.description: Snow from a channel that went off the air. It crackles toward anything warm.
entity.portalgun.static_slug.description: Feeds on static. Pet it and your hair will stand on end - hit it and you get the rest.
entity.portalgun.steam_moth.description: Drinks steam, sheds soot, and is drawn to every clockface it sees.
entity.portalgun.steam_turtle.descriptio: Carries a little hot spring on its back; the mineral crystals grow a ring every century.
entity.portalgun.stiltbird.description: A pink wader on legs twice your height. It stands on one of them for hours.
entity.portalgun.storm_elemental.descrip: A thundercloud with a temper and two glowing eyes. It throws ball lightning.
entity.portalgun.stripe_grazer.descripti: Their stripes confuse lions. Mostly they confuse each other.
entity.portalgun.sulfur_toad.description: Puffs its throat full of sulfur and lobs stinking globs. The smell lingers for days.
entity.portalgun.thorn_hog.description: A walking pincushion with a temper. Hug it at your own risk - it bristles back.
entity.portalgun.thunderbird.description: Rides the storm front with crackling wingtips. Leave its peaks alone.
entity.portalgun.titan_snail.description: Slow as a glacier and big as a house. Tiny things that get in its way get carried along.
entity.portalgun.treasure_mimic.descript: Gold trim, iron lock, and a tongue. The tongue is the giveaway.
entity.portalgun.tripod.description: Three legs, one eye, no mercy. Its heat-ray sets the dust itself alight.
entity.portalgun.twilight_owl.descriptio: Asks 'who?' all evening long. Nobody has ever given it a satisfying answer.
entity.portalgun.umbral_hound.descriptio: Four glowing eyes and no smell of its own. You hear the pack long before you see it.
entity.portalgun.void_jelly.description: A drifting lantern of the void. Its light helps lost travellers see the next island.
entity.portalgun.void_ray.description: Glides between the worldlets on wings full of stars, filtering stardust from the dark.
entity.portalgun.wax_grub.description: A plump, sleepy larva that chews wax all day and squeaks if you step over it.
entity.portalgun.will_o_wisp.description: A lost little light. Stay near one and the dark gets easier to see through.
entity.portalgun.wraith.description: A tattered shape of fog with burning eyes. Look away and it is suddenly closer.
entity.portalgun.yarn_cat.description: Knitted from a single unbroken strand. Do NOT pull the loose end.
entity.portalgun.zephyr_wisp.description: A knot of angry night wind. It does not hurt much - it just pushes you off the island.
item.portalgun.abyssia_bubble_jelly.lore: Pops on the tongue. You can breathe the bubbles.
item.portalgun.abyssia_glow_pearl.lore: Still warm. Something in it is breathing.
item.portalgun.abyssia_maw_fang.lore: Glows faintly at the root, like a lure.
item.portalgun.aerolith_cloudberry.lore: Light as air. Eat one before you jump, not after.
item.portalgun.aerolith_puff_feather.lor: So light it falls upward on windy days.
item.portalgun.aerolith_sky_pearl.lore: Hold it to your ear: you can hear a whale singing far above.
item.portalgun.aurum_greed_gem.lore: Everybody wants one. That is the whole problem.
item.portalgun.aurum_midas_fig.lore: Heavy as a coin purse. Sweet as getting away with it.
item.portalgun.aviary_cloudberry.lore: Weighs less than nothing. Eat two and hold on to something.
item.portalgun.aviary_roc_feather.lore: Hold it up in a strong wind and your feet start getting ideas.
item.portalgun.brickton_loose_brick.lore: The most dangerous object in the multiverse to step on barefoot.
item.portalgun.brickton_snap_sandwich.lo: Bread, cheese, lettuce, bread. Clicks together. Builds character.
item.portalgun.colossia_ant_chitin.lore: Light as paper, strong as a door.
item.portalgun.colossia_honey_glob.lore: One drop from a Mega Bee. Enough for a whole picnic.
item.portalgun.colossia_titan_shell_shar: A flake the size of a shield. The snail did not notice it was missing.
item.portalgun.cronen_gut_string.lore: Like string, but worse in every measurable way.
item.portalgun.cronen_mystery_meat.lore: It was probably somebody. Tastes like chicken anyway.
item.portalgun.cronen_watching_eye.lore: Still blinks when nobody looks at it.
item.portalgun.effervescia_fizz_bubble.l: Never pops in your pocket. Only in your face.
item.portalgun.ember_lion_mane.lore: Still smells of smoke and bad decisions.
item.portalgun.ember_marula.lore: Ripens in the last light. Which is always.
item.portalgun.eventide_moonfox_tuft.lor: Impossibly soft. Shed, not taken - moonfoxes leave them for friends.
item.portalgun.eventide_moonpetal.lore: Tastes like the last minute of a sunset.
item.portalgun.eventide_shade_antler.lor: Its tips still glow, as if it remembers the stag.
item.portalgun.froopy_gummy.lore: Still wobbling. So are your knees.
item.portalgun.froopy_horn_candy.lore: Shed every spring. Tastes like a rainbow's aftertaste.
item.portalgun.froopy_jawbreaker_shard.l: Do not bite. Suck patiently for roughly three weeks.
item.portalgun.gearhaven_cog.lore: Twelve teeth. No idea where it goes.
item.portalgun.gearhaven_mainspring.lore: Wound tight enough to run a city for a week.
item.portalgun.gearhaven_wind_up_biscuit: Turn the key twice before eating.
item.portalgun.glacior_frost_carapace.lo: Cold enough to keep a drink chilled for a week.
item.portalgun.glacior_snowberry.lore: Crunchy, fizzy, and it makes your feet bouncy.
item.portalgun.glacior_yeti_fur.lore: Impossibly warm. Smells faintly of peppermint.
item.portalgun.glitch_corrupted_beef.lor: Tastes like beef.png failed to load.
item.portalgun.glitch_missing_fragment.l: Item name not found. Item lore not found. Item not f
item.portalgun.gloopolis_bounce_jelly.lo: Eat it and your knees forget how gravity works.
item.portalgun.gloopolis_gloopberry.lore: Squishes between your teeth. Glows a little on the way down.
item.portalgun.gloopolis_goo_glob.lore: Still trying to crawl back to the lake.
item.portalgun.glowcap_slice.lore: Tastes like blue raspberry and dirt
item.portalgun.groovy_disco_shard.lore: Every face catches a different colour of light.
item.portalgun.groovy_groove_jelly.lore: Your feet will not stop. Do not fight it.
item.portalgun.groovy_warm_wax.lore: Rises when warm, sinks when cool. So do you, apparently.
item.portalgun.harvestfall_acorn.lore: Squirrels will follow you anywhere for one of these.
item.portalgun.harvestfall_candy_corn.lo: Found stuffed in a scarecrow's pockets. Nobody knows who put it there.
item.portalgun.harvestfall_sweetcorn.lor: Sweet enough to eat raw, warm from the evening sun.
item.portalgun.hivemind_amber_chunk.lore: Something small is still in there, waiting.
item.portalgun.hivemind_drone_stinger.lo: Still twitches when it hears buzzing.
item.portalgun.hivemind_royal_jelly_bite: Meant for a queen. You will do.
item.portalgun.inversia_gravity_silk.lor: Spun by Ceiling Crawlers. It drifts toward the sky.
item.portalgun.inversia_pod.lore: Falls up if you let go of it. Eat it and so do you, a little.
item.portalgun.jurassica_bronto_rib.lore: One rib. Roughly the size of a canoe.
item.portalgun.jurassica_bronto_roast.lo: Feeds a family of twelve. Or one very tired explorer.
item.portalgun.jurassica_raptor_claw.lor: Sharper than it has any right to be. Count your fingers.
item.portalgun.lotus_croc_scale.lore: Thick as a roof tile. The croc did not give it up willingly.
item.portalgun.lotus_dragonfly_wing.lore: Shimmers green, then blue, then a colour you have no name for.
item.portalgun.lotus_root.lore: Crunchy, sweet, and full of little tunnels.
item.portalgun.lumina_lantern_dust.lore: Shaken from a Lantern Bug. It glows for weeks.
item.portalgun.lumina_lumen_fruit.lore: Eat one and the dark stops being dark for a while.
item.portalgun.lumina_panther_fang.lore: Still faintly glowing. So is the bite mark.
item.portalgun.mesa_rift_prickly_pear.lo: Sweet, cool, and only slightly stabby.
item.portalgun.mesa_rift_rattle.lore: Shake it and every lizard on the mesa freezes.
item.portalgun.mesa_rift_turquoise.lore: The colour of the river, if the river were very old and very patient.
item.portalgun.micro_atp.lore: Pure cellular energy. Do not chew.
item.portalgun.micro_cytoplasm_jelly.lor: Mostly water, a little salt and a lot of enthusiasm.
item.portalgun.micro_phage_capsid.lore: Twenty perfect faces and one terrible idea inside.
item.portalgun.oculus_pickled_eye.lore: It blinks if you shake the jar.
item.portalgun.oculus_watcher_lens.lore: Look through it, and something looks back.
item.portalgun.orbitas_stardust.lore: Swept up from the floor of the universe.
item.portalgun.orbitas_starfruit.lore: Tastes like a wish. Eat one before you jump.
item.portalgun.ossuary_bone_marrow.lore: Rich, buttery, and none of your business whose it was.
Still rattles faintly when the others are near.
item.portalgun.paradisia_coconut.lore: Crack it on a rock, drink the inside, swim like a fish.
item.portalgun.paradisia_sea_glass.lore: A bottle, a thousand tides, and a crab with taste.
item.portalgun.plush_felt_cookie.lore: Made of felt. Tastes like cookie anyway. Nobody asks how.
item.portalgun.plush_fluff.lore: Premium unbleached teddy stuffing. Smells faintly of bedtime.
item.portalgun.prismara_crawler_leg.lore: Crunchy outside, luminous inside. You will glow for a while.
item.portalgun.prismara_geode_heart.lore: Still warm. Still beating, very slowly.
item.portalgun.prismara_prism_shard.lore: Splits torchlight into seven colours and one that has no name.
item.portalgun.puffjelly_gel.lore: Lighter than air for about fifteen seconds.
item.portalgun.pyroclast_cinder_pepper.l: Eat one and the lava feels like a warm bath. For a while.
item.portalgun.pyroclast_fire_opal.lore: There is a tiny storm of fire trapped inside.
item.portalgun.pyroclast_magma_core.lore: It beats like a heart. A very hot heart.
item.portalgun.rad_glowshroom_cap.lore: It glows because it is radioactive. You will glow because you ate it.
item.portalgun.rad_mutant_jerky.lore: Three-eyed rat, sun-dried. Might let you see in the dark. Might not.
item.portalgun.rad_uranium_shard.lore: Warm to the touch. Then warmer. Put it down.
item.portalgun.rubra_blueberry.lore: Not a berry. Not blue. Not technically edible. Crunchy, though.
item.portalgun.rubra_heat_lens.lore: Still warm. Point it away from your face.
item.portalgun.rubra_skimmer_silk.lore: Thin enough to read through, strong enough to ride a dust storm.
item.portalgun.sakura_fox_tuft.lore: Warm to the touch, and it smells faintly of blossoms and rain.
item.portalgun.sakura_lantern_ember.lore: A little flame that has forgotten how to burn things.
item.portalgun.sakura_mochi.lore: Left as an offering. The lantern did not mind sharing.
item.portalgun.saltara_brine_shrimp.lore: Stiltbirds eat thousands a day. That is why Stiltbirds are pink.
item.portalgun.saltara_pink_plume.lore: Light enough to float on brine. Pink enough to be suspicious.
item.portalgun.saltara_rock_salt.lore: A perfect cube, every time. Saltara is very particular.
item.portalgun.scrapheap_scrap_bolt.lore: Fits nothing. Fits everything. Depends how hard you hit it.
item.portalgun.selene_helium_crystal.lor: Fuel for a fusion reactor, or a very fancy balloon.
item.portalgun.shattered_rift_heart.lore: Still beating. Every beat is a tiny tear in the world.
item.portalgun.shattered_void_gel.lore: Eat it before the jump. It remembers what falling gently felt like.
item.portalgun.shattered_wraith_splinter: A sliver of the broken sky. It hums in the key of the void.
Two lines and a leaf. Surprisingly crunchy.
item.portalgun.sketchbook_living_ink.lor: It keeps trying to finish a drawing you cannot see.
item.portalgun.snack_cheese_wedge.lore: Aged to perfection by a very proud mouse.
item.portalgun.snack_meatball_bite.lore: Still rolling around a bit. Perfectly seasoned.
item.portalgun.snack_pretzel_twist.lore: Salt rush! Shed by a Pretzel Snake. It doesn't mind.
item.portalgun.spectra_chroma_gel.lore: Tastes like whichever colour you were thinking of.
item.portalgun.spectra_prism_shard.lore: Hold it up to the light and it hums in seven notes.
item.portalgun.spectra_rainbow_mane.lore: Shed, never cut. Unicorns are very particular about that.
item.portalgun.spectral_ectoplasm.lore: Cold, wobbly, and faintly humming a funeral march.
item.portalgun.spectral_hound_fang.lore: Still snaps shut on its own if you leave it on a table.
item.portalgun.spectral_wisp_essence.lor: Drink the light. Try not to think about where it came from.
item.portalgun.spinelands_hog_quill.lore: Barbed both ways. Pull it out slowly. No, slower.
item.portalgun.spinelands_needle_feather: Each barb is sharp enough to sew with. Several have.
item.portalgun.spinelands_rose_hip.lore: Sweet, tart and only slightly stabby.
item.portalgun.stalker_spore.lore: It is warm, and it is not entirely sure it is dead.
item.portalgun.synthwave_glitch_shard.lo: Hold it to your ear: dial-up tones.
item.portalgun.synthwave_neon_filament.l: Still warm. Still humming in B minor.
item.portalgun.tempest_slug_jelly.lore: Tastes like licking a battery. Gets you moving, though.
item.portalgun.tempest_storm_core.lore: Crackles when you shake it. Do not shake it.
item.portalgun.tempest_thunder_feather.l: Smells of ozone. Your hair stands up when you hold it.
item.portalgun.thermalia_geyser_pearl.lo: Grown one boiling layer at a time inside a serpent's throat.
item.portalgun.thermalia_onsen_egg.lore: Slow-cooked in a geyser for exactly one hundred years.
item.portalgun.thermalia_sulfur_gland.lo: Smells like a thousand rotten eggs. Alchemists love it.
item.portalgun.umbra_glimmer_mote.lore: Warm in your hand, like it is glad you are there.
item.portalgun.umbra_lumen_berry.lore: Eat one and the dark steps back. A little.
item.portalgun.umbra_shade_essence.lore: Colder than it should be, and heavier than it looks.
item.portalgun.vitrea_glass_stinger.lore: Hollow, with a drop of pink venom still inside.
item.portalgun.vitrea_prism_fruit.lore: Cool and crisp. Tastes like the color turquoise.
item.portalgun.vitrea_worm_tooth.lore: One of four hundred. It grows a new one every week.
item.portalgun.white_room_blank_wafer.lo: Tastes of absolutely nothing. You become a little bit of nothing, too.
item.portalgun.white_room_shadow_ink.lor: Pours upward when nobody is watching.
item.portalgun.white_room_static_mote.lo: Hums at exactly sixty hertz. Hold it to your ear if you dare.
message.portalgun.bed.time_frozen: Time stands still here - there is no night to sleep through
message.portalgun.empty: Out of portal fluid! Carry a bottle of Portal Fluid to reload.
message.portalgun.reloaded: *glug glug* Portal fluid topped up (%s charges)
tooltip.portalgun.controls: Use: shoot a portal  |  Sneak + Use: open the dial
tooltip.portalgun.portal_fluid: Reloads %s portal gun charges automatically when the gun runs dry
